Family Tree Error Check

Online trees copy each other’s mistakes until a guess looks like gospel. Send us the tree you already have, and we’ll audit it line by line — you get back a downloadable written report of everything that doesn’t hold up, and how we know, plus your tree file so you can use the results in your own software.

What we check for

  • Impossible dates — children born before their parents, mothers aged 8 or 68, people marrying after their own funerals
  • Unsourced claims stated as fact — names, dates, and places with no record behind them
  • Likely duplicates — the same person entered twice under spelling variants
  • Conflated identities — two same-named people merged into one impossible life
  • Conflicting records — censuses, certificates, and memorials that disagree with each other

How it works — automatically

  1. Buy only this check & send your tree One-time payment, no subscription. Send a GEDCOM file or an export from your tree software or site — whatever you have.
  2. The audit runs automatically Every person and claim checked against the dates, the relationships, and the records.
  3. Download your file A downloadable written error report — each finding labeled, with the sources that were checked — plus your tree file, so you can fix your tree with confidence and keep using it anywhere else.

Every finding carries a label — the same standard we use in our own research. No finding is dressed up as more certain than it is:

Verified Supported Inference Conflict

Sample reports

Every order delivers a written report — every finding labeled — plus a downloadable tree file. These samples come from a real test run on a 204-person tree; names and places are changed for privacy.

From a Family Tree Error Check

Scan of the submitted tree — 204 people:

  • Impossible dates (death before birth, etc.): 0
  • Possible duplicate people: 0
  • People with missing birth details: 21
  • People with missing death details: 74
  • People with no sources attached: 19

CONFLICT — A death year. The tree said 1912; the state death index (certificate 6106) says 1913. The index governs, and the tree was corrected.

CONFLICT — A marriage date. The civil marriage index says 16 January; a memorial page says 19 January. Both dates are shown and labeled, and the index date is the one used.

Delivered with the check: a corrected, downloadable GEDCOM file plus the full labeled findings list.

From a One-Ancestor Report ($9.99)

VERIFIED — Parentage. Proven from a sibling’s estate distribution naming him as a brother. An earlier candidate for his father was ruled out by that man’s own estate account, which names all of his children — and he is not among them.

SUPPORTED — Marriages. Three marriages from the civil marriage indexes (1836, 1838, 1848). A later search of church records found none of the three, so the civil indexes remain the only marriage evidence.

VERIFIED — Death and estate. He left no will. His administration bond was filed in November 1851, and the final account names the widow’s one-third share and each son’s share to the cent.

From a Record Lookup ($9.99)

One lookup can fix a tree. The death record we found named the ancestor’s parents — and the mother it names is not the woman the tree had carried for years. The record, made at his death, is the stronger source, so the tree was corrected and the old name kept, labeled as a conflict, instead of quietly disappearing.

Common questions

The questions people ask most before ordering family history research — answered the same way we label our findings: plainly.

How does it work?

Pick the Family Tree Error Check, a research tier, or any single service, and pay once. Then send what you have — a GEDCOM file or an export from your tree software or site for the error check and tiers, or the names, dates, and places you already know for the other services. From there the research runs automatically: ancestors are checked against real records, every finding is labeled, and your finished report and tree file are delivered digitally for you to download.

Is it a subscription?

No. There is no monthly subscription, no membership fee, and nothing that renews. Every order is a single one-time payment — the Error Check starts at $25, research tiers run $25 to $89, and single services start from $9.99. If you order again later, returning customers save 20% with a code at checkout, but you never pay for a month you don’t use.

What file do I get?

A downloadable file that is yours to keep: a written report with every finding labeled Verified, Supported, Inference, or Conflict, plus the sources that were checked — and, where a tree is involved, your tree file (GEDCOM). You can save it, print it, share it with family, and import it into Ancestry, FamilySearch, MyHeritage, RootsMagic, or any other tree program. No subscription is needed to open or use it later.

How long does research take?

It depends on the size of the job. A Starter tier covers up to 50 ancestors, Standard up to 100, and Deep Dive up to 300, and a single brick-wall question can take longer than a straightforward record lookup. Because every job is scoped first, you always get a quote and confirmation before any work starts — so you know the price and the scope up front, and nothing extra is researched or charged without your say-so.

What if nothing is found?

You still get your report — with the honest dead end in it. It shows what was searched and which records were checked, so you can see the trail really does run cold rather than take our word for it. What you will never get is a guess dressed up as an answer: if the records don’t support a claim, the report labels it Inference or Conflict, or says plainly that nothing was found.

    Privacy & Legal

    Last updated: November 15, 2026

    Genealogy research runs on personal information — names, dates, family details, and sometimes a whole family tree file. This page says plainly what we collect, why, how it is stored, and what you can ask us to do with it, followed by the terms that govern every order.

    On this page

    1. Privacy Policy
    2. Terms of Service

    Privacy Policy

    Who we are

    Genealogy Detective Service (“we,” “us”) provides genealogy research services — family tree error checks, research tiers, and single research services — delivered digitally by file and email to customers worldwide. Questions about this policy or your information: admin@tree-detective.com.

    What we collect

    We collect only what an order or a free membership actually needs:

    • Contact details — your name and email address, so we can confirm your order, ask about scope, and deliver your files.
    • Research material you send us — the names, dates, and places you provide, and any family tree file you upload (such as a GEDCOM, up to 8 MB) with a research request.
    • Order details — which service or tier you bought, the scope agreed, and the price quoted.
    • Membership details — if you join the free membership, your name and email, so we can send the weekly newsletter and honor the member discount.

    We never see or store your card number. Payments are handled by our payment provider; card details go straight to them and never pass through us. We see only your name, email, and what you bought.

    How we use it

    • To carry out the research you ordered and assemble your report and tree file.
    • To contact you about your order — a scope question, a quote, or delivery.
    • If you are a member, to send the weekly newsletter with members-only coupons. Every issue can be the last one: ask us to stop and we stop.
    • To keep basic business records of orders and payments.

    That is the whole list. We do not sell your information, rent it, or share it for anyone else’s marketing. Your family details and tree files are never published, posted, or added to any public tree.

    How your information is stored

    • Names, emails, memberships, and research requests are kept in the member app’s private database. Only the owner of Genealogy Detective Service can see the full member and request lists.
    • Passwords are never stored as readable text — they are kept as a salted, scrambled hash, so the database itself does not contain anyone’s actual password.
    • Uploaded tree files are held in private file storage, separate from the request itself. A request holds only a reference and the file name, and downloading a customer’s tree file requires the owner’s login.
    • This public webpage stores nothing at all. Its Feedback and Research Information Sheet forms do not submit anything to a server — they open your own email app with your message addressed to us, and nothing is sent until you press Send in your email. Sign-ups and orders happen in the member app.

    Family information and living people

    Family trees often include living relatives. Please send only what the research needs, and only information you have the right to share. We treat everything you send — about living people and ancestors alike — as confidential research material: used for your order, never published, and never passed to another customer.

    How long we keep it

    We keep order records and delivered research for as long as they are needed for the business records of the sale and in case you return with a follow-up question about your report. Tree files you upload are kept with their request so the work can be checked against them. You can ask for earlier deletion at any time — see below.

    Your choices

    • See it: ask what information we hold about you and we will tell you.
    • Fix it: ask us to correct anything that is wrong.
    • Delete it: ask us to delete your information and uploaded files, and we will — apart from the basic sale record the law requires us to keep.
    • Stop the newsletter: ask once and member emails stop.

    Write to admin@tree-detective.com for any of these. We answer from the same address your files are delivered from, so you know it is really us.

    Cookies

    This page does not run advertising or cross-site tracking. Our payment provider may set its own cookies during checkout, under its own privacy policy, to process your payment securely.

    The Tree Viewer

    The Tree Viewer on this site runs entirely in your own browser. A file you open in it is never uploaded, transmitted, or stored — nothing from it reaches us or anyone else — and closing or reloading the page discards everything it showed.

    Changes to this policy

    If this policy changes, the new version goes on this page with a new date at the top. Changes never apply backwards to information you already sent us under an earlier version.

    Terms of Service

    The service

    Genealogy Detective Service provides genealogy research: a Family Tree Error Check, research tiers (Starter, Standard, Deep Dive), and single research services such as record lookups and ancestor reports. Everything is delivered digitally — a written report and, where a tree is involved, a downloadable tree file (GEDCOM) — by email, to customers worldwide. Prices are in US dollars; at checkout, your payment provider handles conversion into your currency.

    No subscription

    Every order is a single one-time payment. There is no monthly subscription, no membership fee — membership is free — and nothing renews automatically. Returning customers receive 20% off orders after their first, applied with a code at checkout.

    Scope and quotes come first

    Every job is scoped before work starts. You receive a quote and confirmation of the price and scope, and nothing extra is researched or charged without your say-so — including when a tree holds more ancestors than a tier covers, where you choose between upgrading and a per-ancestor quote. If a record set you need is not accessible to us, we tell you before any work starts, not after.

    What research can and cannot promise

    Genealogy depends on records that may be lost, incomplete, contradictory, or never created. We promise the work, not a particular outcome:

    • Every finding is labeled Verified, Supported, Inference, or Conflict, with the sources that were checked.
    • If a trail runs cold, your report shows the honest dead end — what was searched and which records were checked — instead of a guess dressed up as an answer.
    • A service buys the research and the report of it. It is not a guarantee that a specific record exists, that a brick wall can be broken, or that a line can be extended to a particular date.

    Your material, your files

    You keep all rights in the family information and tree files you send us; sending them gives us permission to use them only to do your research. The report and tree file we deliver are yours to keep — save them, print them, share them with family, and import them into your own tree software or site. No subscription is needed to open or use them later.

    Refunds

    If you cancel before research on your order has started, you receive a full refund. Once research is underway, contact us at admin@tree-detective.com and we will settle it fairly based on the work done — and if we cannot carry out an order at all, you are refunded in full. A report that honestly finds nothing is a completed service, not a failed one: it documents every search made on your behalf.

    Acceptable use

    Please send only material you have the right to share, and use our reports for your own family research. Reports may not be resold as a service to third parties, and research may not be ordered to harass, defraud, or intrude on any living person.

    Liability

    Our reports are careful research based on the records available at the time, labeled by how well each finding is supported — but records can be wrong, and new records surface. We are not liable for decisions made in reliance on a finding labeled Inference or Conflict, and our total liability for any order is limited to the price paid for that order.

    Changes to these terms

    Updated terms go on this page with a new date at the top. The terms in place when you ordered govern that order.

    Questions about either document? Write to admin@tree-detective.com — the same address that delivers your reports.
